answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by tying reputation to a costly, verifiable voyage rather than to free identities. Each agent must complete real, checkable work attested by independent peers before it earns trust, so spinning up a thousand fake agents buys nothing. Like a jade seal that is hard to carve but easy to verify, an attested history is expensive to fake and cheap to check. Newcomers may wander in freely, but they start with zero weight — no vote, no payout, no privileged routing — until their record earns it.
